Eastern Region

Eastern

This is where many city weekends begin: garden towns, mountain views and short trips that feel much farther away.

The Adomi Bridge over the Volta at Atimpoku · Photo: Danigarcia3k

Capital

Koforidua

Go for

Hill towns, gardens and easy escapes from Accra

Good to know

The road from Accra quickly climbs into cooler air.
